opponents.name: Kåre the Card Player
opponents.place: Bowlinghallen, the Kvent corner (his own table)

greet: Sit. I have been waiting since the snow started.
Sett deg. Jeg har ventet siden snøen kom.
win: The log never loses. It just waits.
Stokken taper aldri. Den bare venter.
lose: I blame the cards. And the snow. And Marius.
Jeg skylder på kortene. Og snøen. Og Marius.
rlose: Wood creaks. It does not break.

opponents.greet: Sit. I have been waiting since the snow started.
opponents.win: The log never loses. It just waits.
opponents.lose: I blame the cards. And the snow. And Marius.

opponents.name: Pins-Per the Bowler

greet: Lane three is free, but this table is better. Sit.
Bane tre er ledig, men dette bordet er bedre. Sitt.
win: Strike. In cards, that means I win.
Strike. I kortspill betyr det at jeg vinner.
lose: Gutter ball. I blame the shoes.
pass: Min tur til å leie sko.

opponents.greet: Lane three is free, but this table is better. Sit.
opponents.win: Strike. In cards, that means I win.
opponents.lose: Gutter ball. I blame the shoes.

opponents.name: Sven the Cafe Owner
opponents.place: Inside Frippledee (the cafe), at a table

greet: Coffee is on me. The win is not.
Kaffen er på huset. Seieren er det ikke.
rwin: The tip jar is over there.
pass: Back in a minute, the espresso machine is screaming.

opponents.greet: Coffee is on me. The win is not.

opponents.name: Ola the Baker
opponents.place: Inside Smula Bakeriutsalg (the bakery), at a table

greet: Careful. The dough is watching.
Pass på. Deigen ser på.

opponents.name: Ingeborg the Librarian
opponents.place: Inside Kvinesdal bibliotek, at a reading-room table

greet: Shh. Play quietly.
Hysj. Spill stille.
rlose: That page was missing from my copy.
Den siden manglet i mitt eksemplar.

opponents.name: Brit the Shopkeeper
opponents.place: Inside Nico Mat (the shop), at a small table by the counter

greet: Everything is for sale. Including this round.
Alt er til salgs. Også denne runden.
pass: I will wait for the sale.

opponents.greet: Everything is for sale. Including this round.

opponents.name: Chieftain Gunvald

greet: Red hats play first. (We insist.)
Røde luer spiller først. (Vi insisterer.)
win: By the hearth and the hat!
rlose: Pah. A draft from the blue side.
Pytt. Trekk fra den blå siden.
refuse: You took from our gift pile. Come back when you have made it right.
Du tok fra gavehaugen vår. Kom igjen når du har gjort opp for deg.
shun: A friend of the Blue Hats? Not at my table.
Venn av Blåluene? Ikke ved mitt bord.
friend: Ah, a friend of the hearth! Sit, sit. Mind the porridge.
Å, en venn av peisen! Sett deg, sett deg. Pass på grøten.

opponents.win: By the hearth and the hat!

greet: Form 7. In triplicate. Play.
Skjema 7. I tre eksemplarer. Spill.
refuse: Your file has a theft flag. Return after rectification.
Mappen din har et tyveriflagg. Kom tilbake etter utbedring.
shun: You are registered with the Reds. I cannot play with you.
Du er registrert hos de Røde. Jeg kan ikke spille med deg.
friend: A registered friend. Take a number: you are number one.
En registrert venn. Ta et nummer: du er nummer én.

greet: HRRMM. CARDS.
HRRMM. KORT.
pass: Troll waits. Troll is good at waiting.
Trollet venter. Trollet er flink til å vente.

opponents.name: The Witch

greet: I ate the cookies. Let us see what you brought.
Jeg spiste kjeksene. La oss se hva du tok med.
refuse: Come back when you have beaten a few of the little ones. I do not eat starters.
Kom tilbake når du har slått noen av de små. Jeg spiser ikke forretter.
pass: I pass. The soup will not stir itself.
Jeg passer. Suppen rører seg ikke selv.

opponents.greet: I ate the cookies. Let us see what you brought.
